author: NASASpaceflight
description:
This Week in Spaceflight, Stoke Space advances its fully reusable stainless steel Nova rocket with completed Zenith full-flow staged-combustion engines shipping to Cape Canaveral for Pathfinder integration ahead of a planned early 2027 maiden flight, while Relativity Space completes a full-duration Terran R upper-stage hot fire and begins first-stage mating, and Rocket Lab delivers Neutron thrust module and second-stage hardware to Wallops with a growing 16-mission backlog.

The Exploration Company reveals new Nyx Crew capsule renders that closely resemble SpaceX’s Dragon as Europe develops independent crew transportation capability. NASA’s Perseverance rover and long-serving Mars Odyssey orbiter both suspend science operations after radio and reaction-wheel anomalies, JAXA’s Hayabusa2 cancels its 2031 landing attempt on asteroid 1998 KY26 due to ion thruster issues and retargets a 2028 flyby, and Voyager 1 becomes the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth.
